"""Primary review and installation of the bounded recovery hosted evidence."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
import tarfile

from freeze_native_release_298 import ROOT, OUT, save, sha


def main():
    origin = OUT / 'recovery-hosted-package-406'
    archive = origin / 'recovery-hosted-package-406.tar.xz'
    manifest = origin / 'recovery-hosted-package-406.manifest.json'
    assert sha(archive) == '67f558735ebad22e5557d5c0506b8bd1880cb508ddf31a688ce882c45b6bb3c0'
    assert sha(manifest) == 'ce98ff95af048110e01a0f860f608350dcb4588cf77ab540deec6667fbc93712'
    metadata = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
    expected = {row['path']: row for row in metadata['members']}
    assert len(expected) == len(metadata['members']) == 26
    actual = {}
    with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:xz') as stream:
        for item in stream:
            path = PurePosixPath(item.name)
            assert item.isfile() and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
            assert item.name not in actual and item.name in expected
            data = stream.extractfile(item).read()
            assert len(data) == expected[item.name]['bytes']
            assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected[item.name]['sha256']
            actual[item.name] = data
    assert set(actual) == set(expected) and sum(map(len, actual.values())) == 881245
    ci = json.loads(actual['recovery-ci-406/summary.json'])
    checks = json.loads(actual['recovery-ci-406/checks.json'])
    assert ci['status'] == 'passed' and ci['all_accepted_git_blob_sha256_verified']
    assert ci['accepted_source_files'] == 2240 and ci['accepted_git_blob_bytes'] == 42086693
    assert ci['synthetic_merge_tree_identical'] and ci['tree'] == '346dcea90f924aa1a977c1cc42b66e50f4f2bc69'
    assert len(checks['check_runs']) == checks['total_count'] == ci['check_count'] == 44
    assert all(row['conclusion'] == 'success' and row['head_sha'] == ci['head'] for row in checks['check_runs'])
    assert json.loads(actual['recovery-ci-406/reviews.json']) == []
    assert json.loads(actual['recovery-ci-406/inline_comments.json']) == []
    wheels = json.loads(actual['recovery-wheel-hosted-406/index.json'])
    assert len(wheels['hosted_workflow']['jobs']) == 3
    for job in wheels['hosted_workflow']['jobs']:
        log = actual['recovery-wheel-hosted-406/' + job['log_file']]
        assert hashlib.sha256(log).hexdigest() == job['log_sha256']
        assert job['runner_reported_integration'] == dict(tests=80, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=0)
    prod = json.loads(actual['recovery-production-406/report.json'])
    pr = json.loads(actual['recovery-production-406/merged-pr.json'])
    assert pr['merged'] and prod['status'] == 'passed'
    assert pr['merge_commit_sha'] == prod['merged_commit'] == '483cbaa982dd300dec45bb50066cdbf452686b36'
    assert len(prod['responses']) == 4 and all(row['http_status'] == 200 and row['source_preserved'] for row in prod['responses'])
    assert prod['responses'][-1]['raw_byte_identical']
    for row in prod['responses']:
        assert hashlib.sha256(actual['recovery-production-406/' + row['response']]).hexdigest() == row['observed_sha256']
    destination = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-operator-recovery-hosted-2026-10-13'
    destination.mkdir()
    for name in [archive.name, manifest.name, 'recovery-hosted-package-406.verification.json']:
        target = destination / name
        with target.open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write((origin / name).read_bytes())
        assert sha(target) == sha(origin / name)
    review = dict(status='passed', observed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  archive_members=26, uncompressed_bytes=881245,
                  archive_sha256=sha(archive), manifest_sha256=sha(manifest),
                  all_member_bytes_and_hashes_verified=True, material_index_claims_checked_against_raw_evidence=True,
                  primary_helper=dict(sha256=sha(__file__), text=open(__file__).read()))
    review_path = destination / 'primary-review.json'
    save(review_path, review)
    index = json.loads((origin / 'recovery-hosted-package-406.index.json').read_text())
    index.update(status='completed_finite_unit', unit='NATIVE-OPERATOR-RECOVERY',
                 tree_sha256_not_claimed=True, identical_git_tree=ci['tree'],
                 primary_review=dict(path=review_path.name, sha256=sha(review_path)),
                 archive_verification='recovery-hosted-package-406.verification.json',
                 prior_browser_proof='../native-stream-composition-hosted-2026-10-13.json')
    save(destination / 'index.json', index)
    print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed', destination=str(destination), members=26,
                         index_sha256=sha(destination / 'index.json')), indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
